children: Armour Residential REIT provided a November update showing a $21.14 billion portfolio and a $0.24 per-share common dividend.
As of October 31, the portfolio totaled $21.14 billion, with 94.7% in agency investments.
Reported debt-to-equity of 7.6, implied leverage of 8.0 and liquidity of $1.12 billion, equal to 46% of total capital.
The November 2026 common dividend is $0.24 per share; the ex-dividend and record date is November 16, with payment on November 27.
The presentation reported a current dividend yield of 23.1% and a common stock price of $12.45.
